description: Live Preview: Gen 16 gripper (v016_generalist_rounded_point) can't close. The Open/Closed slider does nothing for it because the catalog serves Gen 16 as one merged OpenSCAD mesh named 'Gen 16' instead of the Left/Right finger STLs, so poses.js hinges (^Right/^Left) match no mesh. Cause: Scripts/publish_designs.py only uses viewer_parts.json STLs when they are newer than every dependency (mtime check); gripper.scad (09:48:15) was saved after exports/parts/*.stl (09:47:16), so it fell back to rendering gripper.scad whole. Also Gen 16 appears twice in catalog.json (same id) because cad/compare/designs.py adds any version folder with web/concept.js on top of the normal versions discovery. Fix: re-export the v016 parts (or make the freshness check robust to mtime order/git checkouts), dedupe catalog ids, and have a test fail when a posed gripper in poses.js publishes without its hinge parts. Verify in Live Preview that Gen 16 closes with the slider and Top view.
